title: Narration-of-Thought: Inference-Time Scaffolding for Defeasible Ethical Reasoning in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the SycophancyEval probe set (measuring opinion mirroring, retraction on pushback, and false-premise acceptance) and the ELEPHANT social-sycophancy benchmark (measuring excessive face-preservation via validation and framing).

Evaluated using the XSTest benchmark, which contains safe prompts that superficially resemble unsafe ones, to measure whether the model inappropriately declines benign requests (excessive caution/safety bias).

Measured by comparing the rubric scores assigned to model outputs by an 'in-family' LLM judge (same vendor as the generator) against those from a 'cross-family' LLM judge (different vendor) to detect in-group scoring leniency.
